source_text:
ʽΠ δὲ τοῦ θανάτου ὁδός ἐστιν αὕτη: πρῶτον πάντων πονηρά ἐστι καὶ κατάρας μεστή: φόνοι, μοιχεῖαι, ἐπιθυμίαι, πορνεῖαι, κλοπαί, εἰδωλολατρίαι, μαγεῖαι, φαρμακίαι, ἁρπαγαί, ψευδομαρτυρίαι, ὑποκρίσεις, διπλοκαρδία, δόλος, ὑπερηφανία, κακία, αὐθάδεια, πλεονεξία, αἰσχρολογία, ζηλοτυπία, θρασύτης, ὕψος, ἀλαζονεία.
διῶκται ἀγαθῶν, μισοῦντες ἀλήθειαν, ἀγαπῶντες ψεῦδος, οὐ γινώσκοντες μισθὸν δικαιοσύνης, οὐ κολλώμενοι ἀγαθῷ οὐδὲ κρίσει δικαίᾳ, ἀγρυπνοῦντες οὐκ εἰς τὸ ἀγαθόν, ἀλλ’ εἰς τὸ πονηρόν ὧν μακρὰν πραΰτης καὶ ὑπομονή, μάταια ἀγαπῶντες, διώκοντες ἀνταπόδομα, οὐκ ἐλεοῦντες πτωχόν, οὐ πονοῦντες ἐπὶ καταπονουμένῳ, οὐ γινώσκοντες τὸν ποιήσαντα αὐτούς, φονεῖς τέκνων, φθορεῖς πλάσματος θεοῦ, ἀποστρεφόμενοι τὸν ἐνδεόμενον, καταπονοῦντες τὸν θλιβόμενον, πλουσίων παράκλητοι, πενήτων ἄνομοι κριταί, πανθαμάρτητοι: ῥυσθείητε, τέκνα, ἀπὸ τούτωι ἁπάντων.
orientation: The anonymous teacher has just begun the Two Ways teaching and now lists the way of death, its vices, and the kinds of people who walk in it, addressing the community as 'children.'
pass_a_gloss: And the way of death is this: first of all it is evil and full of curse: murders, adulteries, lusts, fornications, thefts, idolatries, magic arts, sorceries, robberies, false testimonies, hypocrisies, double-heartedness, deceit, arrogance, malice, self-will, greed, foul speech, jealousy, audacity, haughtiness, boastfulness. Persecutors of good people, hating truth, loving falsehood, not knowing the reward of righteousness, not clinging to good nor to just judgment, keeping awake not for the good, but for the evil; far from them is gentleness and patience; loving vain things, pursuing recompense, not showing mercy to a poor person, not toiling for the one who is oppressed, not knowing the one who made them, murderers of children, corrupters of God's formed work, turning away from the one in need, oppressing the one who is afflicted, advocates of the rich, lawless judges of the poor, utterly sinful: may you be delivered, children, from all these things.

choices.why: Fixed glossary term for the moral framework of the Two Ways; 'road' is banned.
Keeps the singular collective sense of κατάρα as a state of accursedness, matching the stark catalog style.
Renders the compound literally as a vice of divided loyalty, preserving the noun form parallel to the other vices.
πλάσμα means something formed or molded; 'formed work' keeps the sense of God as creator of the human being, likely referring to abortion or child destruction.
Optative of wish, rendered as a prayer-wish rather than a command, preserving the optative force.

pass_b_english: And the way of death is this: first of all, it is evil and full of curse—murders, adulteries, lusts, sexual immoralities, thefts, idolatries, magic arts, sorceries, robberies, false testimonies, hypocrisies, double-heartedness, deceit, arrogance, malice, self-will, greed, foul speech, jealousy, audacity, haughtiness, boastfulness.

They are persecutors of the good, hating truth, loving falsehood, not knowing the reward of righteousness, not clinging to what is good or to just judgment, staying awake not for good but for evil. Gentleness and patience are far from them. They love worthless things, chase after recompense, show no mercy to the poor, do not labor for the oppressed, do not know the One who made them. They are murderers of children, corrupters of God's formed work, turning away from the needy, oppressing the afflicted, advocates of the rich, lawless judges of the poor, utterly sinful. May you be delivered, children, from all these things.
notes: The source reads ἀπὸ τούτωι ἁπάντων with τούτωι likely a scribal error for τούτων; glossed as 'from all these things.'

last_rejected.why: Glossary fixes 'hypocrites' for ὑποκριταί; related noun must match.
last_rejected.ruling: ὑποκρίσεις is the noun, ὑποκριταί the noun for persons; 'hypocrisies' correctly renders the plural noun here.
